verdict.rationale: Wise documents business payments from a Wise account and describes its platform as offering domestic and cross-border payment tools. Nothing confirms outbound ACH or wire rails to vendors: the ACH evidence covers direct debit for funding batches, not paying recipients. missing for 10: explicit outbound domestic ACH payment support, domestic wire support, vendor-payment workflow documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
